g.text: A Distributed Edge System for Collecting Wildfire Data
LoRa field nodes • Jetson edge processing • live dashboard • burn validation

text.tspan: Build a deployable sensing network that can
measurements around active or controlled fires.
Key priorities: low-power field sensing, long-range
and rapid visualization during burn experiments.
